title: admin: Users page (list, create, edit, disable, delete, reset password)
description: Admin SPA half of epic budget-bst (tk show budget-bst). Add a Users page to admin/ (today it only has the jobs ledger: admin/src/App.tsx, api.ts, pages/): navigation between Jobs and Users, a table of users, create user, edit name / role / status, delete, reset password. Create and reset show the server-generated temp password once, with a copy button and a note that it expires in 7 days and must be changed at first sign-in. Depends on budget-uns: start your branch from its branch.
notes:
Users page built in admin/ (pages/Users.tsx, users.logic.ts + test, api.ts user contracts + error code, nav, 401 notice). Verified in a real run against the budget-uns API (auth on, throwaway DB, dropped): create, temp password dialog, edit, disable, reset, duplicate-email refusal, delete, self-row limits, 401 notice. No contract problems found.
Validator (budget-opf): PASS. tsc/build/bun test (7) green; real run (auth on, throwaway PG, dropped) confirmed user_has_data, cannot_modify_self (API), Escape closes temp-password dialog and the password is gone from the DOM, nothing in URL/localStorage/sessionStorage. Minor findings: (1) Users.tsx:188 comment says backdrop closes the dialog but there is no backdrop handler (native <dialog> does not); (2) Users.tsx:114 Disable/Enable has no in-flight guard (double click sends two PATCHes) and its notice (line 66) is never cleared except by the next flip; (3) /me failure => isSelf false, no hint shown, server still refuses (Users.tsx:45); (4) network failures show the raw fetch message (users.logic.ts:90); (5) narrow window: table overflows to ~990px, row actions off screen (styles.css, no scroll wrapper).
Polish pass (345f7c0): per-row busy guard + notice cleared on action/dialog open; table-wrap overflow-x; Modal backdropClose only for confirm dialogs; destructive actions locked while /me unresolved; network error message. tk/budget-uns has no new commits.
Merged tk/budget-uns 07f996b; invalid_input (reserved e-mail) now has a readable message + test.
Approved by Yuri (Plannotator Inbox, 2026-11-20): merge to local main, no push. Admin Users page (list, create, edit, disable, delete, reset password, one-time temp password dialog). Validator PASS, polish 345f7c0 and e2ef547. admin tsc, build, 7 tests pass; walked end to end in the integration run. Landed on local main as merge d58b239.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Users table shows e-mail, name, role, status, sign-in methods (password / Google), must-change and temp expiry, locked-until, last seen. 2) Create, edit (name, role, status), delete and reset password call the /admin/users contracts from shared (same call() helper pattern as jobs; types from the contracts). 3) The temp password is shown only in the result of create/reset, is not kept after the dialog closes, and is never written to the URL, localStorage or console. 4) Delete and reset ask for confirmation; API refusals (self, last admin, user_has_data, 409 existing e-mail) are shown as readable messages; the row for the signed-in admin has disable/demote/delete turned off. 5) The 401 notice still works and mentions that signing in at the app also works. 6) Logic that can be pure is tested; screenshots of the list, the create dialog and the temp-password result attached as evidence. 7) admin/: tsc --noEmit and the production build pass (plus tests if the package has a test setup).
